message:
Devaj,

We're putting together a small dinner in SF with folks building in developer tools, LLM infrastructure, and AI—Louan and Artem are confirmed, among others. Your work on contact-aware control for dexterous manipulation keeps coming up in conversations about embodied systems actually needing physical interaction to learn properly, and that perspective would add something real to the room. Grabbing 8 people max, early next month.

Want in?
